name: target-pace-card
title: Target pace card
description: A goal with a deadline: the current value, a bar with a tick where an even pace would be today, the verdict in words and the daily rate still needed.
docs: Dates are calendar days in `timeZone`. Pass `now` from the server so the verdict is the same on the server and in the browser. Today counts as half a day, so the answer does not drift while the page is open. Far ahead reads as words ("Well ahead of pace"), never as a four-digit percentage.
